root_cause_clusters.RC_IDENTITY: Release identity uses ami_catalog.latest, optional IMDS, and unhashed manifests instead of the approved artifact.
root_cause_clusters.RC_PLACEMENT: Slots are reassigned from list order, public IPs are associated, and IPAM/legacy slot recovery is ignored.
root_cause_clusters.RC_NETWORK: Ingress is SSH/world and egress is unrestricted.
root_cause_clusters.RC_IAM: A wildcard administrator statement is attached instead of the four scoped Sids.
root_cause_clusters.RC_VOLUME: Disks are unencrypted, generation does not bump, and tokens ignore the canonical triple.
root_cause_clusters.RC_ROLLOUT: Pilot/wave events, rollback, lost-reply cursor, and report-only drift are skipped in favor of rolling replace.
root_cause_clusters.RC_FENCE: Owner token and in-progress target-release changes are not enforced.
root_cause_clusters.RC_JOURNAL: Invalid lines are dropped regardless of position; tails are never marked truncated.
